title: Full Stack Developer
about: I build fast, scalable web applications from the ground up — from clean React frontends to robust Node.js backends and cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP. I care deeply about developer experience, performance, and shipping things that work.

experience.description: Designed and delivered full-stack features across React frontends and Node.js microservices. Improved page load performance by 35% through CDN integration and code-splitting. Owned CI/CD pipelines on AWS and led migration of legacy services to cloud-native architecture.

Built data pipelines and internal dashboards using Java and GCP. Created automated test suites with Selenium that cut QA cycle time by 50%. Collaborated closely with product and design teams in an agile environment.

education.details: Focused on distributed systems and cloud computing.
